name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars

after.name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
after.candidate:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have appSub : ∀ (l₁ l₂ r₁ r₂ : List CoreIdent), l₁.Subset r₁ → l₂.Subset r₂ →
      (l₁ ++ l₂).Subset (r₁ ++ r₂) := fun _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂ a Ha => by
    simp only [List.mem_append] at Ha ⊢
    rcases Ha with Ha|Ha
    . exact Or.inl (h₁ Ha)
    . exact Or.inr (h₂ Ha)
  have key : ∀ (e : Expression.Expr), NormalizedOldExpr e →
      (extractOldExprVars e).Subset (Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars e) := by
    intros e
    induction e with
    | const => intros _ a Ha; simp [extractOldExprVars] at Ha
    | bvar => intros _ a Ha; simp [extractOldExprVars] at Ha
    | op => intros _ a Ha; simp [extractOldExprVars] at Ha
    | fvar => intros _ a Ha; simp [extractOldExprVars] at Ha
    | abs _ _ _ ih =>
      intros Hnorm
      cases Hnorm
      exact ih ‹_›
    | quant _ _ _ tr e trih eih =>
      intros Hnorm
      cases Hnorm with | quant H1 H2
      exact appSub _ _ _ _ (trih H1) (eih H2)
    | app m fn e fn_ih e_ih =>
      intros Hnorm
      cases Hnorm with | app H1 H2 Hn
      unfold extractOldExprVars
      split
      . simp [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
        intros a Ha
        exact Ha
      . next Hfalse =>
        exfalso
        specialize Hn ?_
        constructor
        cases Hn
        apply Hfalse
        rfl
      . exact appSub _ _ _ _ (fn_ih H1) (e_ih H2)
    | ite _ c t e cih tih eih =>
      intros Hnorm
      cases Hnorm with | ite H1 H2 H3
      exact appSub _ _ _ _ (appSub _ _ _ _ (cih H1) (tih H2)) (eih H3)
    | eq _ e1 e2 ih1 ih2 =>
      intros Hnorm
      cases Hnorm with | eq H1 H2
      exact appSub _ _ _ _ (ih1 H1) (ih2 H2)
  intros Hnorm a Ha
  exact key post Hnorm Ha
